name: @tcpassos/moodle-student-mcp

tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign the user in to Moodle. Call it when another Moodle tool says the user is not signed in, or when the user wants to connect or switch accounts. Pass `site_url` the first time (ask the user for their Moodle address if you don't know it). A browser window opens on this computer, the user signs in there (SSO and MFA work) and this call waits for it. In environments without a screen (cloud sandboxes, SSH, containers) it explains how to configure MOODLE_URL and MOODLE_TOKEN instead. Never ask for the user's Moodle password or token.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Show whether the user is signed in to Moodle, as whom, on which site and where the credential comes from (environment or saved sign-in). Never reveals the token.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Remove the Moodle sign-in saved on this computer. Does not revoke the token on Moodle; the user can do that in Moodle under Preferences > Security keys.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Confirm who the user is on Moodle: name, user_id, site, Moodle version, the number of web service functions available and the time zone used for dates.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List the courses the user is enrolled in: id (used by the other tools), name, short name, progress (%) and last access.

tools.name: get_course_contents
tools.description: List the sections/topics of a course and their activities (name, type, url, description and completion state when Moodle exposes it). Use the `id` from list_courses.

tools.name: list_assignments
tools.description: List assignments with due date, cutoff date, opening date and max grade. Omit `course_ids` to search all courses. Returns assign_id for get_submission_status.

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Show the user's own submission for an assignment: status, submission time, whether it can still be edited, grade and teacher feedback. Any status other than "submitted" means it was not turned in.

tools.name: get_upcoming_deadlines
tools.description: List upcoming deadlines from Moodle's Timeline (assignment due dates, quiz closings, ...) sorted by date. The best single source for what is due and when. Items without a due date do not appear here.

tools.name: get_grades
tools.description: Show the user's grades in a course: each grade item with grade, max, percentage, weight and feedback.

tools.name: list_forums
tools.description: List the forums in the user's courses, including the announcements forum (type "news"). Omit `course_ids` to scan all courses. Returns forum_id for get_forum_discussions.

tools.name: get_forum_discussions
tools.description: List the most recent discussions of a forum (title, author, date, opening message). Good for teacher announcements.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the downloadable files of a course (PDFs, slides, notebooks, ...): filename, mimetype, size, section, activity and the `fileurl` to pass to download_files.

tools.name: download_files
tools.description: Download course files to a local folder and return each file's local `path`, so it can be opened and read. Pass `fileurls` from list_files, or omit them to download every file in the course. Files already downloaded with the same size are reused (status "cached").

instructions:
Read-only access to the user's Moodle as a student: courses, contents, assignments, submission status, deadlines, grades, forums/announcements and course files.
If a tool says the user is not signed in, call `login`: it opens a browser window where the user signs in, without any password or token passing through the chat. Never ask the user to type their Moodle password or token.
